kali-server._comment: Kali official MCP Server. Available after apt install mcp-kali-server. Any terminal tools such as nmap/nxc/curl/gobuster can be called directly.

metasploit-mcp._comment: Metasploit Framework MCP interface. apt install metasploitmcp. Support exploit/payload/session management.

hexstrike._comment: HexStrike AI MCP. apt install hexstrike-ai. Automated orchestration of 150+ security tools.

pentestswarm._comment: Pentest Swarm AI. Swarm intelligence autonomous penetration framework. go install or Docker. Supports --swarm mode.

anything-analyzer._comment: Browser Automation + HTTP Capture. You need to clone and start pnpm dev first.

idapro._comment: IDA Pro MCP. Requires IDA Pro Linux version + ida-pro-mcp plug-in. The port may be incremented to 13350.

ghidra._comment: Ghidra MCP. apt install ghidra + GhidraMCP plugin. Free IDA alternative.
